explanation: The prior scorer compared signals with a mutable spot quote at the time the script was run after a minimum 24-hour age. It did not use one fixed target horizon or immutable point-in-time outcome prices. Its percentage is not predictive accuracy.

legacy_observation.method: Mutable current CoinGecko quote at invocation; minimum age 24 hours; variable realized horizon; score thresholds; a separate 2% tolerance for neutral scores; no fixed target timestamp or baseline comparison.
